title: Challenges to and Restoration of the Congress System

topics.title: Challenge of political succession: from Nehru to Shastri to Indira Gandhi
topics.ncert_sections: Challenge of Political Succession; From Nehru to Shastri; From Shastri to Indira Gandhi

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the succession after Nehru raised doubts about India's democracy and how it was resolved.
Describe the challenges India faced during Lal Bahadur Shastri's Prime Ministership.
Explain how and why Indira Gandhi was chosen as Prime Minister in 1966.

topics.title: Fourth General Elections, 1967: context and non-Congressism
topics.ncert_sections: Fourth General Elections, 1967; Context of the elections; Non-Congressism

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the economic and social crisis that formed the background to the 1967 elections.
Explain the strategy of non-Congressism and Ram Manohar Lohia's argument for it.

topics.title: Electoral verdict of 1967, coalitions and defection

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the results of the 1967 elections at the national and State levels.
Explain the nature of the SVD coalition governments formed after 1967.
Explain the meaning of defection and the 'Aya Ram, Gaya Ram' phenomenon.

topics.title: Split in the Congress: Indira Gandhi vs the Syndicate
topics.ncert_sections: Split in the Congress; Indira vs. the 'Syndicate'; Presidential election, 1969; Abolition of Privy Purse

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the Syndicate and analyse how Indira Gandhi turned her power struggle with it into an ideological one.
Explain how the 1969 Presidential election led to the formal split of the Congress.
Explain what the privy purse was and how it came to be abolished.

topics.title: The 1971 election and restoration of Congress
topics.ncert_sections: The 1971 Election and Restoration of Congress; The contest; The outcome and after

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the composition and weakness of the Grand Alliance of 1971.
Explain the purpose of the 'Garibi Hatao' slogan in Indira Gandhi's political strategy.
Interpret the results of the 1971 Lok Sabha election and their consequences.

topics.title: Restoration? The nature of the new Congress

concepts.learning_objective: Compare the new Congress under Indira Gandhi with the old Congress system.
Analyse why democratic spaces shrank despite the consolidation of the Congress.
